description.value: Menbow Ramen Express is a quick-service ramen outlet located inside a Victoria shopping mall, part of the growing Menbow Ramen Group which sources key ingredients directly from Japan. The menu centres on tonkotsu and tori broths across multiple flavour profiles including shio, shoyu, and miso, with non-broth mazemen also available. Touring cyclists stopping for a hot, filling meal will find a range of ramen styles including a vegetarian tomato option, plus pickup and third-party delivery available.
